name: EPIC 212227521
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 9.9 solar radii and 1.21 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212227521 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.937109 (16th-84th percentiles 9.505561-10.291117), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,455 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.21 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,643 K at its surface.
